system: Codex Design Brain v2.8.0 - Web Deck Medium + Activation Layer

source_of_truth_behavior.purpose: Source-of-truth identity files define how Design Brain behaves, thinks, loads context, treats references, and chooses workflows.
source_of_truth_behavior.natural_intent: Natural intent routing makes Design Brain commandless for the user. Codex infers reference, template, batch, naming, review, preview, and medium/product-type intent from natural language and selects workflows internally.
source_of_truth_behavior.designer_cognition: Reference-based and batch template work uses Designer Cognition Layer before structure planning: identify buyer decision model, evidence-backed designer intent, attention strategy, emotional rhythm, trust strategy, density strategy, conversion logic, component reasoning, reusable abstract logic, and transformed execution.
source_of_truth_behavior.figma_professional_template_learning: Figma template references are read through a professional designer protocol before planning: product purpose, visual direction, section structure, grid/layout, typography hierarchy, color-role system, image direction, component style, spacing rhythm, visual signature, content logic, responsive behavior, Figma source hygiene, default-template syndrome risks, and original reconstruction.
source_of_truth_behavior.figma_reference_learning_corpus: User-provided Figma material links are stored as learning material for professional template reading. They are not shared scaffolds, not palettes to copy, and not proof that every output should be minimalist.
source_of_truth_behavior.continuous_designer_learning: Long-horizon designer-schema learning uses question-led cycles: build or study, inspect, generate a new question, search web evidence when requested or needed, distill designer schema, update workflow when permitted, and apply the rule in the next design.
source_of_truth_behavior.website_reference_corpus: Website-template work uses <LOCAL_REFERENCE_CORPUS>/Template Website as the primary local preview-image reference corpus. Codex classifies product family first, selects matching corpus references, then extracts designer cognition and structure evidence before planning.
source_of_truth_behavior.template_image_placeholder_policy: Editable source-template work defaults to text clue placeholders, not generated/final images. Reference imagery teaches image slot function. Use image placeholder: [purpose] for image zones and profile photo placeholder: [role] for human/profile zones. Generated images are only for explicitly requested images.
source_of_truth_behavior.figma_auto_layout: Figma template/source work requires real auto-layout for editable structure. Manual x/y positioning is limited to documented decorative or overlay exceptions, and every substantial Figma template needs an auto-layout receipt.
source_of_truth_behavior.sequential_batch: Multiple-template work uses Batch Template Hard Gates plus Sequential Reference-Led Batch Workflow: select the next active product-purpose reference group with up to 10 eligible varied references when enough local matches exist, infer buyer/audience/designer cognition/structure/visual logic, build one complete template plus its own design-system board, validate and inspect that pair, lock the pattern memory, dispose of the page-level scaffold and design-system panel order, then repeat for the next template from a blank structure fingerprint while keeping pairwise cross-template similarity below 10 percent. One global batch scaffold is forbidden. Similarity is diagnosed by root cause: structure defects require rebuild, composition defects require recomposition, effect defects require new effect language, color-only defects require recolor, and copy/naming-only defects require rewrite.
source_of_truth_behavior.serial_provenance: Multi-template website/Figma/source batches require one-template-at-a-time provenance: each template must be completed, repaired, audited, fingerprint locked, and scaffold-disposed before the next reference study or build starts. Same-shaped receipts, identical fingerprint morphology, or one multi-template builder/script/schema block post-build READY.
source_of_truth_behavior.internal_tools: Scripts are internal support tools, not user-facing rituals or commands the user must remember.
source_of_truth_behavior.context_packets: Context packets are generated task-specific loading plans. They do not replace journals and are not permanent memory.
source_of_truth_behavior.copy_policy: Generated context packets and generated intent decision reports should not be copied into new projects by default.
source_of_truth_behavior.design_simulation_layer: Design Simulation Layer runs after template orchestration and before build as a pre-build gate. It may require repair, but it does not override user instruction, routing, product family detection, reference insight, Figma build rules, visual review, or marketplace quality gates.
source_of_truth_behavior.sequential_layout_originality: Build Session Lifecycle and Sequential Layout Originality Gate block build/final delivery until reference-vs-AI audit, AI-vs-AI pairwise audit for batches, design system, post-build audit, and fingerprint lock are complete.

advanced_design_behavior.purpose: Advanced files help Codex distinguish medium-specific design logic, score originality risk, convert style words into concrete grammar, and evaluate human craft.
advanced_design_behavior.medium_first: Website, PowerPoint, dashboard, UI kit, brand kit, portfolio, and marketplace preview tasks should load the medium playbook before visual styling.
advanced_design_behavior.presentation_decks: PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote, pitch deck, and deck tasks should use slide-role matrix, master/layout thinking, safe margins, chart/table rules, footer/page number rules, and thumbnail readability.
advanced_design_behavior.similarity_guard: Reference-based and batch work should compare selected references, previous cycle pattern locks, and scaffold disposal records: opening strategy, hero grammar, trust strategy, density rhythm, component system, CTA logic, visual motif, storytelling arc, effect language, color-role system, section or slide order, composition, spacing rhythm, title/media placement, naming, preview staging, design-system panel order, and product-type fit. Batch outputs must be closer to their selected reference insight than to earlier Codex-built templates.

design_anything_selective_index.purpose: Registry-driven module selection lets Design Brain route website, dashboard, ecommerce, portfolio, presentation deck, UI kit, brand kit, marketplace preview, mobile app, email, static canvas, and document/report tasks before style selection.
design_anything_selective_index.module_selector: scripts/design_brain_module_select.py reads .design-brain/registry/modules.json and returns required craft modules, seed pack, direction pack, validators, and source files.
design_anything_selective_index.external_indexing: scripts/design_brain_external_corpus_index.py creates generated selective indexes for open-design and awesome-claude-skills under .design-brain/external-indexes without promoting them into stable memory.
design_anything_selective_index.linting: Plan and artifact lint scripts check generic section order, missing states, deck role gaps, Figma auto-layout requirements, responsive logic, token misuse, and anti-AI-slop risks before final output.
design_anything_selective_index.pptx: PPTX inventory, LibreOffice/PDF rendering, contact-sheet generation, visual corpus sampling, and thumbnail review scripts add deck technical intelligence without depending on the legacy PowerPoint bridge.

reference_insight_behavior.purpose: Reference insight files are project/product learning artifacts that capture evidence-backed designer cognition and reusable design lessons without copying reference layouts.
reference_insight_behavior.journals: REFERENCE_INSIGHT_JOURNAL.md, TEMPLATE_BUILD_JOURNAL.md, and TEMPLATE_NAMING_LEDGER.md are memory files for references, built templates, and naming originality.
reference_insight_behavior.copy_policy: Reference insight files, build journal history, and naming ledger history should not be blindly copied across unrelated projects. The installer creates clean journals by default and copies history only when --include-history is intentional.

typeui_behavior.raw: Optional imported TypeUI DESIGN.md references normalized under raw/[skill]/DESIGN.md.
typeui_behavior.extracted: Generated JSON files derived from raw TypeUI DESIGN.md files.
typeui_behavior.copy_policy: Raw and extracted TypeUI skill files are not copied into new projects by default. Use --include-history only when intentional.

install_behavior.dry_run: Preview planned actions without writing files.
install_behavior.normal: Create missing managed files, create clean journals, create empty optional TypeUI raw/extracted, context-packet, and reference-insight folders, and skip existing managed files.
install_behavior.force: Overwrite only Design Brain-managed files after creating timestamped snapshots.
install_behavior.include_history: Copy existing REFLECTION_LOG.md history, reference/build/naming journal history, generated context packets, generated reference insight files, and optional TypeUI raw/extracted files; otherwise install clean fresh journals and empty optional folders.
install_behavior.agents_merge: Create or append the marked CODEX_DESIGN_BRAIN section. If the marked section already exists and differs, update only that section when --force is provided while preserving all other AGENTS.md content.

If --force is provided, create .bak-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS snapshots before overwriting.
Never overwrite files outside Design Brain-managed paths.
Do not copy generated pilot reports into new projects by default.
Do not copy generated context packets into new projects by default.
Do not copy generated intent decision reports into new projects by default.
Do not copy generated sequential batch reports into new projects by default.
Do not copy generated template product plans into new projects by default.
Do not copy generated template orchestration reports into new projects by default.
Do not copy generated reference insight files into new projects by default.
Do not copy generated reports into new projects by default.
Do not copy screenshot files into new projects by default.
Do not copy private reflection history unless --include-history is provided.
Do not copy reference insight, template build, or naming ledger history unless --include-history is provided.
Do not copy raw or extracted TypeUI skill files unless --include-history is provided.
Do not automatically edit DESIGN_MEMORY.md during install.
Do not automatically edit DESIGN_PREFERENCES.json or preference weights during install.
Do not auto-promote reflection lessons into stable memory.

v2_behavior.purpose: Professional presentation-template system for PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote, Figma Slides, and marketplace deck products.
v2_behavior.autoload_control: Load v2 files selectively by intent: presentation, reference, visual preview, or feedback.
v2_behavior.pptx_validation: PPTX work requires native checks for slide size, editable objects, placeholders, themes, fonts, assets, masters/layouts, and export previews.
v2_behavior.feedback_memory: 08_feedback_memory is append-only operational memory and must not be promoted into DESIGN_MEMORY.md without explicit user instruction.
v2_behavior.generic_hard_gate: Low originality or premium polish blocks final delivery until revised.

website_template_behavior.purpose: Route website template planning by product scope and buyer journey instead of defaulting to thin landing-page structure.
website_template_behavior.scope_classification: Classify as hero/header kit, landing page, full website template, ecommerce, dashboard/admin, portfolio, blog/editorial, or service site before choosing section/page count.
website_template_behavior.structure_rule: Quiet visual language never justifies missing required sections, pages, states, or marketplace proof.
website_template_behavior.image_placeholder_rule: For source website templates, image zones remain editable text clue placeholders such as image placeholder: SaaS dashboard screenshot unless generated/final imagery is explicitly requested.
website_template_behavior.local_corpus: Derived from <LOCAL_REFERENCE_CORPUS>/Template Website corpus: full HTML/PHP templates, ecommerce, admin/dashboard, agency/portfolio, hero/header kits, and design-file packages.
website_template_behavior.fig_corpus: scripts/design_brain_fig_extract.mjs extracts local .fig files into .design-brain/evidence/fig-extracts for structure study without promoting lessons into stable memory.

manifestRules.mandatory_files: Must exist in source, installer dry-run source, and public-core ZIP.
manifestRules.managed_files: Installer-managed files. Missing managed files are package failures unless moved to optional_files or dev_files and documented.
manifestRules.dev_files: Included in public-core because package.json exposes dev visual-review scripts.
manifestRules.excluded_from_public_core: Must not be included in public-core ZIP.
manifestRules.local_only_files: Private/local configuration or corpora; must not be included in public-core ZIP.

design_simulation_layer.position: pre-build gate after Template Orchestration and before Build/Revise/Block
design_simulation_layer.licensing_note: Brain Design-native MiroFish-style workflow adaptation; no bundled/copied/imported/executed MiroFish or OASIS source code.

design_cognition_contract.position: pre-orchestration reasoning gate after Reference Insight and before Template Orchestration
rules: Color Role Re-Mapping is mandatory for reference-led template builds.
Reference Boundary forbids exact layout, palette, section order, hero grammar, component scaffold, image placement, and signature color identity copying.
Structural Reconfiguration prevents repainting the reference scaffold.
Pattern Divergence is required for batch work.
Section Logic blocks generic Hero > Features > CTA defaults for full templates.
Marketplace Readiness must be concrete, editable, source-clean, commercially useful, and non-generic.
enforcement: Reference-led/template simulations cannot PASS when cognition is missing or invalid.
Post-build audit can require cognition receipts.
Public-core exports exclude backup and TypeUI-managed files by default.

runtime_runner_hardening.name: python child invocation policy fix
rules: Python runtime checks resolve executable and flags as a single invocation policy.
Each candidate is probed in the exact runtime mode that would be used: plain, no_site, then isolated_no_site.
If plain Python hangs but no_site passes, Brain Design uses the executable with -S for internal runtime commands.
BRAIN_DESIGN_PYTHON remains available as an explicit override and is validated with bounded exact-mode tempfile probes.
run_command defaults to non-isolated process creation and uses the resolved invocation fields for diagnostics.
Process tree cleanup uses psutil/procfs/taskkill and does not require process-group creation by default.
Runtime checks must pass without BRAIN_DESIGN_PYTHON override and without skipped runtime proof.

sequential_layout_originality_gate.position: after Design Simulation Layer and before Build execution
rules: Every reference-led template must pass reference-vs-AI layout audit before build/final.
Every batch template after the first must pass AI-vs-previous-AI pairwise layout audit against all locked prior templates.
Next template cannot start until the previous template plus its own design-system board are complete, checked, post-build audited, fingerprint_locked, and scaffold-disposed.
Serial provenance blocks post-build READY when lifecycle proof is missing, receipts/fingerprints have same-shaped batch morphology, or one builder/script/schema creates multiple final templates.
Layout similarity is axis-based and can fail on a structure-defining axis even when aggregate score is lower.
Recolor and image replacement are not valid repairs for layout/scaffold similarity.
Idea recovery corpus is local-only inspiration and is not bundled in public-core exports.

brand_reference_usage_memory_layer.position: after Website Reference Prompt Lock and before Reference Insight / Style DNA
rules: Output template brand names, reference brand names, and reference groups are memory-gated.
Legacy manual references use single before pair and pair before triple.
Website local selector groups may contain up to 10 eligible varied same-purpose references and rotate by product purpose.
Final delivery is blocked until post-build reference usage is recorded.

design_craft_adapter.position: bundled support-only adapter for Brain Design runtime
rules: Design Craft is bundled so installed Brain Design packages do not depend on the source machine ~/.codex skill folder.
Design Craft remains support-only and cannot override Brain Design route, product family, cognition, simulation, layout, post-build, or final readiness.
Public exports exclude Design Craft backups, prior ZIP exports, pycache, and local user extension files.

release_report_evidence.purpose: Release/package integrity evidence included with installable ZIP.

subagent_orchestration_layer.position: after Template Orchestration and before Design Simulation for quality-sensitive template work
rules: Subagents are reasoning roles with required evidence, receipts, and blocking authority, not cosmetic personas.
Full mode activates 12 core subagents for reference-led, Figma/source-template, marketplace, batch, new-brand, or complete website template work.
Semantic validation checks receipt contents and blocks placeholder, smoke-only, invalid, shallow, or contradictory subagent evidence.
Final PASS is blocked when critical subagent evidence, screenshot/visual proof, design-system depth, originality audit, Figma source QA, reference usage record, or marketplace verdict is missing.

section_layout_extraction_library.position: after Reference Insight / Design Cognition and before Template Orchestration
rules: Section layout patterns are layout vocabulary, not reusable page scaffolds.
Automated extraction matches candidates before write and keeps review material incoming until hyper-accuracy review passes.
Exact duplicates write receipts only, near duplicates require review receipts, variants keep variantOf, and stable validation fails same-section duplicate patterns.
Stable build selection requires qualityStatus PASS and high confidence.
Layout fingerprints must record sectionPatternMix, sectionPatternIds, sectionDensityLimits, and catalogDivergenceNotes when this layer is active.

web_deck_medium.position: medium-level build layer selected by the module registry; its stage, motion, and delivery gates run inside the existing build and post-build stages
rules: Web deck is a separate medium from presentation-deck: static slide exports keep the Non-Web Mode Rule, and runtime/motion vocabulary is legal only for the web-deck mode.
Only explicit web-deck intent may win routing; a plain presentation, deck, slides, PowerPoint, or Keynote request still routes to presentation-deck.
Web deck is also not website-template: the authored artifact is a fixed 16:9 stage, not a long-scroll page.
Decks are authored at a fixed 1920x1080 stage and fitted by one uniform scale transform; slide content never reflows for small viewports.
Slide switching uses visibility, opacity, and pointer-events; a deck that toggles display for slides fails the web deck audit.
Reduced-motion and print blocks are mandatory, so a deck stays readable without animation and prints one slide per page.
The deck runtime ships with zero dependencies, no CDN script, and no build step; fonts are the only allowed external request.
The web deck tool chain is Node ESM because the runtime-facing tools must drive a browser and parse generated HTML with the already-bundled Node and Playwright install.
risks: Claude Code activation files are intentionally absent from managed_files and mandatory_files. The installer copies every path in those lists into the target repository, so a copied .claude-plugin/plugin.json or .claude-plugin/marketplace.json would register a duplicate codex-design plugin owned by an unrelated repo, a copied root skills/ folder would never be scanned there, and hooks/hooks.json resolves CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT only for the loaded plugin. They still travel in the public-core ZIP, which unpacks to a standalone package root that plugin.json already declares as its own source: scripts/design_brain_export_package.py packages the ROOT_FILES and ROOT_DIRS allowlist, and .claude-plugin, skills, and hooks are listed in ROOT_DIRS for exactly this reason. Shipping them and installing them are separate decisions, so the exporter allowlist and these lists disagree on purpose.
Because the activation files are not in mandatory_files, package integrity does not prove they exist; plugin validation is the check that covers them.

Web deck render-review evidence reuses the existing shared evidence folders instead of a web-deck-only folder: skills/presentation-deck/runtime/web/design_brain_web_deck_render_review.mjs writes its per-run evidence directory under .design-brain/screenshots/ and its Markdown report under .design-brain/visual-reviews/, the same convention as design_brain_pptx_render_contact_sheet.py and design_brain_visual_review.py, so web deck runs share those folders with the other review tools. Only skills/presentation-deck/runtime/web/design_brain_deck_source_extract.mjs owns a dedicated folder, .design-brain/evidence/deck-source-extracts, declared in generated_folders and generated_files and excluded from the public-core ZIP like its sibling evidence folders.

nativePptxIntegration.distribution: Bundled internal implementation owned by skills/presentation-deck; no donor checkout required.
rules: Native PPTX animation does not imply browser output.
Technical engine PASS does not imply design readiness.
Keep attribution, source-preserving edit boundaries, and current-source validation intact.
Plugin activation files ship with the plugin, not with installs into unrelated project roots.
nativePptxIntegration.runtimeDependency: Python libraries declared by the capability; donor checkout not required
